convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'simple_trading_system' and external library TradeAlgorithms.mqh for all trade execution (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_). Custom indicator and external library logic must be manually recreated.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: UpSignal triggers SELL_Close if SellPosClose enabled; DnSignal triggers BUY_Close if BuyPosClose enabled

Historical bar scan for opposite close signal: when both open and close on same side are enabled (e.g. BuyPosOpen && BuyPosClose) but no close signal on current bar, EA scans historical bars from SignalBar+1 onward for the first opposite signal to set close flag

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size or percentage depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: EA reads two buffers from custom indicator 'simple_trading_system': buffer 1 (UpValue=buy signal) and buffer 0 (DnValue=sell signal). Non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE means active signal. Signal is checked on bar index defined by SignalBar input (default=1, previous bar). When both open and close flags are enabled for the same direction and no close signal exists on the current signal bar, EA performs a historical scan from SignalBar+1 to end of chart to find the first opposite signal, setting the close flag if found. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can independently disable long entries, short entries, long exits, or short exits. Recount flag triggers recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator 'simple_trading_system' must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python - it outputs buy/sell signals on two buffers (0=sell, 1=buy) as non-zero/non-EMPTY_VALUE. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and CIsNewBar - all must be reimplemented. Position sizing logic depends on MarginMode enum (5 modes). The historical bar scan for opposite close signals adds complexity. The SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points and may need digit-adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers (check if TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles this). Signal timestamp (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to open functions and may be used for expiration or duplicate-trade prevention.
